newsitem.title: UK: Shire Pharma to start Phase II Lambda trials.
newsitem.headline: Shire Pharma to start Phase II Lambda trials.

text.p: Britain's Shire Pharmaceuticals Group Plc said on Friday it would begin Phase II trials in July for its Lambda development project, which is aimed at treating kidney disease.

"Our Phase I findings are highly encouraging since they point to Lambda having the potential to be an effective, well tolerated treatment, free from the systemic side effects of existing therapies," the company said in a statement.
Shire said Lambda should help regulate blood phosphate levels in kidney disease patients, who need daily therapies to counteract the rise in blood phosphate in their systems.
The company estimated the future global market for Lambda could be worth up to 1.2 billion stg.
Shire aims to develop and market Lambda through its own sales force in the U.S.
The company said it was in ongoing talks to find a licensing partner in Japan.
